subject: Get group names of GWS6 units

messages.author: e3daea24651c4835
messages.subject: Get group names of GWS6 units
parts:
Hi,

I'm doing an allele-specific copy-number analysis with GWS6 chips.
Thus I'm using

> print(csC)
AffymetrixCelSet:
Name: TRIBE
Tags: ACC,ra,-XY
Path: probeData/TRIBE,ACC,ra,-XY/GenomeWideSNP_6
Chip type: GenomeWideSNP_6,Full
Number of arrays: 96
Names: TRIBE_A01_155716, TRIBE_A02_155732, ..., TRIBE_H12_155906
Time period: 2007-07-06 15:40:27 -- 2007-07-09 14:45:08
Total file size: 6324.31MB
RAM: 0.11MB

plm <- AvgCnPlm(csC, mergeStrands=TRUE, combineAlleles=FALSE, shift=
+300)
ces <- getChipEffectSet(plm)

and I get what I expect:

> print(ces)
CnChipEffectSet:
Name: TRIBE
Tags: ACC,ra,-XY,AVG,+300
Path: plmData/TRIBE,ACC,ra,-XY,AVG,+300/GenomeWideSNP_6
Chip type: GenomeWideSNP_6,Full,monocell
Number of arrays: 96
Names: TRIBE_A01_155716, TRIBE_A02_155732, ..., TRIBE_H12_155906
Time period: 2008-04-23 14:16:44 -- 2008-04-23 14:17:31
Total file size: 2587.13MB
RAM: 0.13MB
Parameters: (probeModel: chr "pm", mergeStrands: logi TRUE,
combineAlleles: logi FALSE)

Then I can extract CN values with
thetaAlleles <- extractMatrix(ces);
> dim(thetaAlleles)[1]
[1] 2816383

Everything seems fine. I am now trying to get unitNames and groupNames
for this matrix, but I'm not sure how to proceed.
ugcMap <- getUnitGroupCellMap(ces)
unitNames <- getUnitNames(cdf, units=ugcMap$unit)
unitGroupNames <- getUnitGroupNamesFromUgcMap(cdf, ugcMap=ugcMap,
verbose=verbose)

The problem here is that getUnitGroupNamesFromUgcMap() never ends.
Actually if think it is going to take 2 weeks to accomplish at this
rate (more than one minute for 100 units) and I wonder where is the
bottleneck. I guess this is also the reason why extractDataFrame()
never ends when I try to get more than a few hundreds units.

I guess there is a more efficient way of getting this information but
I don't find it. Has anybody got any leads on how to proceed?

Thank you so much!
Nicolas

BTW: It seems that currently, only total copy-number chip effects can
be normalized with fragment length. Is this something that is planed
for future developments? Thank you!

I've committed a patch making getUnitGroupNamesFromUgcMap() take 50sec
instead of 14 days for the complete GenomeWideSNP_6 ;) The former
version was only tested on subsets of units and the processing time
did unfortunately increase more than linearly. Do

library(aroma.affymetrix);
downloadPackagePatch("aroma.affymetrix");
